[ce] Limit.vi

Owning Palette: Calculus

Determines the left and right limits of a 1D function at the given point.

Click the parameters for more information

 

delta. Distance to the left and right neighbor of point.
point. Point at which the limits have to be calculated.
formula info. The cluster contains information describing 1D function.
formula. Describes a function. Syntax is determined by CalcExpress expression syntax.
x-variable. Name of variable used in formula.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
left limit. Left limit of the given function at point.
right limit. Right limit of the given function at point.
ticks. Time in milliseconds to produce the results.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
